limits: Staged explicit one-shot monitor only: no background timer/cron, source capture, archive upload, production service/schedule/bootstrap, default transport, real alert sink/recipient or provider calls. Persistent cadence is not proof that a real service wakes on time or delivers notifications.

Private SQLite stores trusted target/context, opaque version receipt and redacted operational state/outbox, not encryption/provider keys or archive plaintext. Context/key separation and custody need actual qualification. Owner-private path/inode/schema/checksum/clock checks trust parent paths, same-user host/process isolation and an honest monotonic clock; no malicious-host authentication or power-loss durability claim.

Read-only health checks may expire/reclaim because their only external action is archive reading; late results are CAS-discarded. This never applies to source writers, uploads or STARTED/UNCERTAIN alerts, which are not expired or automatically replayed. Alert sink ACKs are synthetic callback evidence, not authenticated end-user delivery; explicit operator reconciliation remains unimplemented.

Outbox bounded64; only confirmed delivered history is trimmed, unresolved records remain, sticky overflow requires future operational retention/reconciliation. A healthy archive never erases delivery uncertainty or qualifies recovery.

Complete runtime/operator/raw/credential/lifecycle/deferred/process-tree writer coverage and started/legacy reconciliation, urgent-outage fallback NOT_IMPLEMENTED, installed trusted source transport/bootstrap/key custody, actual independent private card-free destination/separate key/context, capture/monitor schedule/readback/age/failure/alerts, current least-privilege PITR and isolated live-cloud restore/interruption/rollback/RTO/RPO remain open. All production controllers/bindings/keys remain uninstalled; no partial fence activation.

No live family-data/schema/credential/permissions/provider/storage/retention/billing mutation, phone/APK/UI change, R2/card/paid dependency, PR merge or deployment. Previous B2 read-only connection/no-visible-bucket observation is historical, not refreshed or destination qualification. Existing failed Cloudflare login/read barriers not retried.

Full signed native recovery retains synthetic trusted controls/bootstrap, legacy outer writer envelope, paused scheduler and synthetic disk-backed B2 provider. Existing Miniflare RPC-stub disposal warnings remain. No physical-device, browser field, independent custody, alert or actual provider/cloud recovery acceptance.
